newsitem.title: THAILAND: Alphatec says fails to make Eurobond payment.
newsitem.headline: Alphatec says fails to make Eurobond payment.

text.p: Thailand's Alphatec Electronics Plc failed to pay holders of its euroconvertible bonds, who last month exercised the put option on the company's $45 million worth of eurobonds, a company official said on Monday.
The firm failed to make payment during a 15-day grace period after a bond put option came due on June 22, the official said.
Trustee Bankers Trust will decide at 3.00 pm Zurich time (1400 GMT) whether to call a default or a bondholders meeting giving the firm a further 30-45 day grace period, the official siad.
"Bankers Trust can now either call a default or accept our restructuring plan and call a meeting of bondholders which would give the company another 30-45 days' grace," the official said.
